name: per_group_transpose
description: Per-expert transpose. a is [M,K] and expert_offsets is a length-(E+1) int32 cumulative offset vector. For each expert segment [start,end), the output's flat segment starting at start*K is a[start:end].transpose(0,1).contiguous().reshape(-1), i.e. K-major within the segment. m_alignment is accepted but unused. Returns a new tensor with a's shape. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with K 16/64/128 and uneven/empty expert segments; benchmarks use K up to 4096.
